source.description: Six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet reviewed as one cumulative graphite and colored-pencil process before cropping.
source.notes: Honest 2026-05-05 archive lesson. Keep one open folding hand fan at one near-front angle with one pivot, two guard ribs, five inner ribs, one pleated leaf, one cord loop, and one tassel; no person, hand, text, logos, scenery, or final-only decoration.

process_strategy: Lock the fan around one low pivot and seven fixed radial ribs, wrap the same geometry with a pleated leaf and guard handles, establish the cord and tassel, then add graphite values and restrained alternating color only inside shapes already drawn.

final_elements.name: low pivot, top arc, two outside rays, and seven radial rib guides
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one open fan spread with exactly two outside guards and five evenly spaced inner ribs.

final_elements.name: complete pleated fan leaf, two wooden guard handles, five inner ribs, and pivot cap
final_elements.description: A broad scalloped fan leaf wraps the fixed rib geometry while the two guard handles extend below the pivot.

final_elements.name: six fold channels, lower leaf edge, and simple rib joints
final_elements.description: Clear fold valleys separate the leaf panels and connect them to the established pivot structure.

final_elements.name: one cord loop and one tapered tassel
final_elements.description: A single cord exits the pivot and ends in one compact tassel beside the right guard handle.

final_elements.name: graphite fold values, warm wood pencil, alternating indigo and terracotta leaf color, paper highlights, and broken cast shadow
final_elements.description: Restrained colored pencil separates the existing leaf panels, ribs, handles, tassel, and shadow while preserving visible paper tooth.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens the established guards, five inner ribs, six folds, pivot, cord, tassel, restrained colors, highlights, and broken shadow.

rejection_checks: No rib, fold, handle, pivot part, cord, tassel, color area, highlight, or shadow may first appear in the final panel.
Exactly seven ribs must radiate from the same pivot with the same fan spread, angle, scale, and crop in every panel.
Reject hands, people, faces, lettering, logos, floral scenes, extra tassels, decorative borders, glossy illustration, vector-like symmetry, or finished detail hidden beneath the tassel.
Every dark pre-final line must survive in the finish unless it is explicitly a pale erasable construction guide.
